title: His reputation as a heavy drinker
summary: He kept getting fired and returning because of drinking, and how hard it is to shake that reputation.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah. I'd get fired and come back. [LAUGHS] Well, that's because I imbibed, I guess, a little bit too much. You know? But anyway, it was a hard fighting, fighting back, being...having a name as being a heavy drinker, you know. You got a hard fight to fight back that reputation. There's a whole lot of guys that got it and never did get out of it, so they just kept on drinking, you know -- because nobody would hire them. There's a few yet that guys won't hire because they think they drink too much. You know? But I don't know. I think if you can drink and control yourself... But I guess everybody thinks they can control it, but they...you know... Well, so much for that.
